items.s: How many integrated steel plants are operated by SAIL?
items.x: SAIL runs 5 integrated steel plants: Bhilai, Durgapur, Rourkela, Bokaro and Burnpur (IISCO).

items.s: Stainless steel is an alloy of –
items.x: Stainless steel is an alloy of iron with chromium (at least about 10.5%), often with nickel; chromium gives the rust resistance.

items.s: Which of the following Iron and Steel plants is not close to a raw material area?
items.x: Salem (TN) stainless steel plant was set up away from raw-material areas for regional balance; Jamshedpur, Rourkela and Durgapur lie in the iron-ore/coal belt.

items.s: Bokaro Steel Plant was constructed with the collaboration of –
items.x: Bokaro (1964), the fourth public-sector steel plant, was built with Soviet (Russian) help; Durgapur was British, Rourkela German.

items.s: The local supply of coal is not available to :
items.x: VSL Bhadravati (Karnataka) is the only plant outside the coal area; it used charcoal. TISCO, Durgapur and Bhilai draw local/nearby coal.

items.s: Which of the following places does not have Iron and Steel industry?
items.x: Jharia is a coalfield in Jharkhand, not a steel centre; Jamshedpur, Durgapur and Bhilai have steel plants.

items.s: The Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel Ltd is located at
items.x: Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel (Mysore steel works, 1923) is at Bhadravati, Karnataka.

items.s: In which of the following places is the copper industry established?
items.x: Khetri (Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan) is the copper centre; Tarapur is nuclear, Titagarh paper, Ranchi heavy engineering.

items.s: Which one of the following centres is not known for iron and steel industry?
items.x: Renukoot (UP) is HINDALCO's aluminium plant, not iron and steel; Bhadravati, Salem and Visakhapatnam have steel plants.

items.s: Choose the incorrect statement.
o: India is the largest producer of raw jute and jute goods in the world.
India stands first in the world in sugar production.
India stands first in the world in jaggery production.
India stands ninth in the world in crude steel production.
items.x:
Printed key: sugar (books long gave Brazil as top sugar producer). As printed, 'ninth in crude steel' is plainly false – India is 2nd (PMF H&E Geography 05 p.26).
India is the world's 2nd-largest crude steel producer, so 'ninth' is the incorrect statement; India is the largest producer of jute and jaggery and was the largest sugar producer in 2021-22, so the sugar statement is defensible.

items.s: Bhilai is primarily a centre of which industry?
items.x: Bhilai is primarily an iron and steel centre; Jamnagar, Vadodara and Haldia are the petrochemical centres.

items.s: Which steel plant has won the Prime Minister's Trophy for the Best Integrated Steel Plant eleven times?
items.x: Bhilai has won the Prime Minister's Trophy eleven times.

items.s: Which one of the following is NOT a pre-Independence steel plant?
items.x: Bhilai was established after Independence. TISCO, IISCO at Burnpur and Bhadravati are listed as pre-Independence plants.

items.s: In which year did Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel Works, Bhadravati come under SAIL?
items.x: VISL came under SAIL in 1989; SAIL itself was set up in 1973, and Mysore State founded VISL in 1923.

items.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
items.x: Bokaro Steel Plant was established with USSR collaboration. Bhilai, Rourkela and Durgapur were respectively associated with the USSR, West Germany and the UK.

items.s: Which of the following pairs of steel plants and collaborating countries is correctly matched?
items.x: Rourkela (1959) was built with West German collaboration and was India's first public-sector integrated steel plant.

items.s:
Assertion (A): Salem is SAIL's stainless steel plant.
Reason (R): Visakhapatnam is the first shore-based integrated steel plant in India.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
items.x: Both are true, but the Vizag plant being shore-based has nothing to do with Salem being SAIL's stainless steel plant.

items.s: Which one of the following groups represents steel plants located away from the main raw-material areas for balanced regional growth?
items.x: Salem, Visakhapatnam and Vijayanagar are examples of plants located away from the principal raw-material areas for balanced regional development.

items.s: Which one of the following sets consists only of coastal or port-oriented steel plants?
items.x: Visakhapatnam, Hazira and Dolvi are examples of coastal or port-oriented steel plants.

items.s: What is the main iron-ore source of the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant?
items.x: Vizag steel's main ore source is Bailadila (Chhattisgarh), not Bellary.

items.s: In which year did the government take over IISCO, Burnpur?
items.x: IISCO, a pre-1947 private undertaking, was taken over by the government in 1976 and is associated with SAIL.

items.s: In which year was the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) set up?
items.x: SAIL was set up in 1973.

items.s: Which is India's first shore-based integrated steel plant?
items.x: Visakhapatnam (RINL) is the first shore-based plant; Hazira and Dolvi are later coastal plants.

items.s: From where does the Bhilai Steel Plant mainly get its iron ore?
items.x: Bhilai draws ore from Dalli Rajhara; Vizag uses Bailadila ore.

items.s: Which steel plant used charcoal and was the only plant outside the coal area?
items.x: VISL Bhadravati (1923, Mysore State) used charcoal and was the only plant outside the coal area.

items.s: Which was the fourth public-sector steel plant of India, set up in 1964?
items.x: Bokaro (1964, USSR help) was the fourth public-sector steel plant after Rourkela, Bhilai and Durgapur.

items.s: What is Mission Purvodaya related to?
o: Making eastern India a steel hub
items.x: Mission Purvodaya aims to develop eastern India as an integrated steel hub.

items.s: Coastal steel plants such as Visakhapatnam, Hazira and Dolvi mainly import coking coal from which country?
items.x: Coastal plants use imported coking coal, mainly from Australia.

items.s: Where are the plants of NALCO (1981), a Navratna under the Ministry of Mines?
items.x: NALCO's plants are at Damanjodi and Angul; Korba belongs to BALCO and Renukoot to HINDALCO.

items.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
items.x: Renukoot (UP) is an aluminium centre (Hindalco); Bhilai is an iron and steel centre.

items.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
items.x: Malanjkhand is a copper centre; Tundoo is a zinc centre and Khetri a copper centre.

items.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
items.x: Hindustan Copper Limited has units at Khetri, Ghatsila–Mosabani and Malanjkhand. Damanjodi and Angul belong to NALCO, while Visakhapatnam Steel Plant belongs to RINL.

items.x: INDAL is linked with Muri, Alupuram and Belagavi, not Jharsuguda. Jharsuguda has India's largest aluminium smelter, run by Vedanta. BALCO–Korba, NALCO–Damanjodi and HINDALCO–Renukoot are correct.

items.x: Textile India-1997 was held in New Delhi (printed key; ITPO textile fairs of 1997 were at Pragati Maidan).

items.x: The Security Paper Mill of the Government of India is at Hoshangabad (Narmadapuram), MP; Nashik and Dewas have security presses, not the paper mill.

items.src: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
items.s: Which wood seasoning method involves applying heat in an enclosed space to remove moisture?
items.x: Kiln seasoning dries timber with heated air inside a closed chamber (kiln), where temperature, humidity and air flow are controlled, so it is quick and uniform. Air seasoning stacks timber in open, shaded air; solar seasoning uses the sun's heat in a simple solar kiln without forced heating; chemical seasoning uses salt solutions to slow surface drying.

items.src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer and Analyst Grade-II
items.s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding coal mining in India?

(I) Since March 1960, SCCL is a joint undertaking of the Government of Assam and the Government of India, sharing its equity in a 45 : 55 ratio.

(II) In 1973, the various privately owned coal mines at Raniganj were nationalised.

(III) National Coal Development Corporation Ltd. (NCDC) was set up in 1956.
items.x: (I) is wrong – SCCL is a Government of Telangana–Government of India company sharing equity 51:49, not Assam 45:55. (II) is right – non-coking coal mines incl. Raniganj were nationalised in 1973. (III) is right – NCDC was set up in 1956. So II and III.
